newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CVRD still a buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said it has reiterated its buy recommendation on Brazilian mining giant Cia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) after first-half results showed a 127 percent jump in net income.
-- "We expect more positive surprises from the company and more developments to take place as the new senior management unfolds its new strategy," Salomon analyst Mauricio Reveco said in a report.

-- CVRD, which was privatized in May, reported on Wednesday a 252.2 million-real first-half net profit, or $0.65 per share, compared with 111.1 million reais, or $0.29 per share, in the same period last year.
-- "This excellent return is mostly due to the improvement of the gross margin from 26.5 percent in 1996's first half to 30.5 percent in first-half 1997," Reveco wrote.
-- The company also announced a 50-percent dividend policy for first-half 1997 which is expected to result in a 126 million total payout.
-- CVRD's blue-chip preferred was up 0.3 perecent at 30.19 reais while its common was untraded at its Wednesday close of 25.20 reais at 1051 local/1351 GMT in Sao Paulo.
